calibration_methodology: Out-of-sample purged validation quantiles on epistemic variance

benchmarking.critique_reference: Meinert, Gawlikowski & Lavin (2023) - The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Deep Evidential Regression

quantile_definitions.theta_soft: Q_0.75: 75th percentile of cross-validated epistemic variance (Triggers Tier 1 Soft Buy-Freeze)
quantile_definitions.theta_elevated: Q_0.90: 90th percentile of cross-validated epistemic variance (Triggers Tier 2 De-Grossing)
quantile_definitions.theta_extreme: Q_0.99: 99th percentile of cross-validated epistemic variance (Triggers Tier 3 Systemic Freeze)

hysteresis.description: To transition up to Tier k, u_t >= theta_k. To de-escalate down to Tier k-1, u_t <= theta_k * (1 - delta_hysteresis) for at least 3 consecutive trading sessions.

tier_0.name: Normal Execution
tier_0.portfolio_action: Full model allocation, standard horizon (20d/60d), complete turnover budget

tier_1.name: Soft Buy-Freeze
tier_1.portfolio_action: Zero new long initiations, horizon shortening to 5d, hold existing positions with tight trailing collars

tier_2.name: De-Grossing
tier_2.portfolio_action: Systematic 50% linear gross de-leveraging, liquidation prioritized by high asset-level uncertainty

tier_3.name: Systemic Freeze
tier_3.condition: u_t >= theta_extreme OR Exchange Circuit Halt OR Structural Breach
tier_3.portfolio_action: 100% immediate liquidation to risk-free cash/T-bills, complete cancellation of all pending broker order slices
